content:
DeferredRegister is the primary way to register blocks, items, and other registry entries in NeoForge. It provides a clean API for mod registration that defers actual registration until the proper game lifecycle phase.

Factory methods:
- create(Registry<T>, String modId): Create for any registry
- createBlocks(String modId): Specialized for blocks
- createItems(String modId): Specialized for items

Registration methods:
- register(String name, Supplier<T> supplier): Register with custom factory
- registerSimpleBlock(String name, BlockBehaviour.Properties): Simple block without custom class
